declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this declaration on behalf of Hargrove Lane LLP in support of preliminary approval. Counsel negotiated the class fund and attorneys’ fees during the same negotiations; fees were not reserved for discussion until after class relief was agreed. The negotiations produced a $30.5 million class fund for automatic payments to identified class members, plus $4 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any fees the Court does not award will go to the class, not Brightline. In my judgment, the settlement provides substantial relief without requiring members to file claims, while avoiding the material risks of class certification and trial and the delay of continued litigation. The Court must independently assess both the settlement and the requested fee.
